properties.content:

Incident Time: 2007-01-23 14:30:00
Nearest City: Blaine, WA
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 60 feet by 40 feet (area 2400 sq. ft.)
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0.06 gallons
THE CALLER STATED THAT THERE IS A SHEEN IN THE WATER AT BLAINE HARBOR. THE CALLER STATED THAT THIS IS RELATED TO A REPORT THAT WAS MADE ON 18JAN2007. THE SUSPECTED RESPONSIBLE PARTY HAD THE SHEEN CONCENTRATED AROUND HIS VESSEL ON THAT DATE. THE PERSON STATED THAT IT WAS NOT HIS VESSEL AS THE BILGE WAS TURNED OFF, BUT WHEN HIS BILGE WAS CHECKED, THERE WAS OIL RECOVERED ON A PAD. THE VESSEL WAS THEN SUSPICIOUSLY MOVED TO CANADA TO HAVE REPAIRS ON THE BILGE. THERE WAS A SHEEN DISCOVERED THIS MORNING AGAIN AT ABOUT THE SAME TIME THAT THE VESSEL LEFT.
